answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by metering entry at a single wharf where every arriving identity must present the same ferrous bond and wait while independent reviewers inspect its first ten tasks. Duplicate work is visible through a prism of cross-checked task hashes: reviewers compare each submission against the signed record and flag any claim that reappears under a second key. A fake fleet must therefore pay a full bond and a full review cycle per hull, while one honest agent pays once.
